# laranex-schema contract fixtures

Copied unchanged from `laranex-schema-viewer-ui` (`contract/`, commit 13a6a50): the JSON Schema, the synthetic valid and
invalid documents, and the graph conformance cases. The Python contract layer must accept every valid document,
reject every invalid one with the listed errors, and build exactly the expected links for every graph case. Update the
copy when the contract's version changes; never edit it here.
